claims.evidence: Price is a seller statement, not shown in photo; no price data in report.
Machine is wrapped in plastic film, obscuring surface condition; no close-up of casing without wrap.
No test print, scan, or output sample shown in the photo; report notes working condition and print quality are not shown.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal faults
risks.proof: A video of the machine powering on and producing a live printed/copied page

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, cracked panels) hidden under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides with plastic wrap removed

risks.risk: Unknown exact model/variant affects feature set and value tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model/serial number label on the back or inside panel
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-spec SHARP copier/printer in this class

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, drum/toner cartridges, trays)
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out next to the machine
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Low or empty toner/ink, drum wear
risks.proof: Photo of toner/drum unit and a test print showing full-page coverage

risks.risk: Age/usage history unknown, could be heavily used
risks.proof: Photo of the page/copy counter on the control panel display
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, near end-of-life

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and completing a print/copy job
Close-up photos with plastic wrap removed, all sides
Clear photo of model and serial number label
Photo of included accessories (power cable, cartridges, trays)
Photo of the control panel showing the page/copy counter
response.reason: The item type (SHARP multifunction copier) is confirmed by the witness, but working condition, exact model, and hidden damage are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
